briefdescription.para: Copies process stdout/stderr to System.out/err in background threads.

detaileddescription.para: This is necessary when Gradle has redirected file descriptors and inheritIO() doesn't work. Uses byte-buffer based copying (like Gradle's implementation) for better performance and to capture all output including partial lines.

parameterdescription.para: the process whose streams to copy

simplesect.para: list of threads copying the streams
